description: Each month a store owner can spend at most MaxExpenditure on carrots and cucumbers. A carrot costs the store owner CostCarrot and a cucumber costs the store owner CostCucumber. Each carrot is sold for a profit of ProfitCarrot and each cucumber is sold for a profit of ProfitCucumber. The owner estimates that the number of cucumbers sold is at most CucumberFraction of the number of carrots sold. He also estimates that at least MinCarrots but at most MaxCarrots are sold each month. How many of each, carrots and cucumbers, should be sold in order to maximize the profit?

MaxExpenditure.definition: Maximum monthly expenditure on carrots and cucumbers

CucumberFraction.definition: Maximum ratio of cucumbers sold to carrots sold

MinCarrots.definition: Minimum number of carrots sold per month

MaxCarrots.definition: Maximum number of carrots sold per month

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from selling carrots and cucumbers"

constraints.description: CostCarrot * (number of carrots sold) + CostCucumber * (number of cucumbers sold) <= MaxExpenditure
(number of cucumbers sold) <= CucumberFraction * (number of carrots sold)
